label: Face
notes: surfacing/facing; first-shot feed/DOC should be conservative because it often touches full stock width

label: Pocket
notes: closed-region rough clearing; full-slot starts and internal corners are the critical load cases

label: Profile
notes: inside/outside contour; corner engagement spikes and tab/link safety matter

label: Adaptive
notes: constant-engagement rough clearing; radial WOC / chip thinning are first-class

label: VCarve
notes: variable effective diameter; chipload target is approximate and must be depth-aware

label: Rest Machining
notes: remaining-stock cleanup; must not assume fresh stock where previous tool removed material

label: Inlay
notes: V-bit plug/pocket fit; geometric fit quality is a non-load gate

label: Zigzag
notes: raster clearing; boundary overshoot and repeated air passes are the likely failures

label: Trace
notes: single-path engraving/scoring; sparse geometry means air-cut threshold is looser than surface finishing

label: Drill
notes: Z-only peck cycle; legacy chipload/engagement are n/a

label: Chamfer
notes: bevel edges; effective diameter grows with chamfer depth

label: 3D Finish
notes: parallel raster surface finish; stepover/scallop is a quality gate

label: 3D Rough
notes: 3D load-limiting rough; deep DOC + low radial WOC should preserve chip thickness

label: Waterline
notes: constant-Z contours; semi-finish stock and cusp on slopes matter

label: Pencil Finish
notes: crease/concavity tracing; sparse but finish-quality sensitive

label: Scallop Finish
notes: constant-cusp finishing; optimizer must not treat looser scallop as free runtime

label: Steep/Shallow
notes: hybrid waterline/raster; both slope regimes need quality checks

label: Ramp Finish
notes: continuous Z descent; no-retract safety and DOC transitions matter

label: Spiral Finish
notes: spiral surface finish; final stepover/cusp gate applies

label: Radial Finish
notes: radial spoke pattern; center crowding and finish cusps are main non-load risks

label: Horizontal Finish
notes: flat shelf finishing; only useful on near-horizontal areas

label: Project Curve
notes: sparse projected curves; high air-cut can be normal, collision is primary

label: Pin Drill
notes: stock registration holes; same drill gates as Drill
